name: Portopia Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
original_name: ポートピア連続殺人事件
source:
Kouzou Yamakawa, the president of the Loan and Savings Company, was found dead inside his mansion. Despite all the evidence indicating that it was a suicide, a detective (i.e. you) and his assistant arrive at the scene for further investigation. 
The player must resolve the mystery of a murder by searching for clues, interacting with characters, and solving item-based puzzles.

[summary from Wikipedia and [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.net/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
translation:
贷款储蓄公司社长山川耕造被发现死在自己的宅邸中。尽管所有证据都表明这是一起自杀事件，一名刑警（也就是你）仍与助手赶到现场展开进一步调查。
玩家必须搜寻线索、与角色互动并解开以物品为基础的谜题，从而揭开这起谋杀案的真相。

[简介整理自Wikipedia及[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.net/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
